integrity: An infinite-domain proof via orbit-barycenter simplicial identification and binary subspace classification is supplied. Finite exhaustive tests through dimension six corroborate rather than certify all cases.
scientific_limitations: Theorem is about geometric fixed spaces of nontrivial binary translation subgroups at inclusive Hamming scale two, not arbitrary isometries or the ordinary homotopy type; a third relevant paper was inspected only at abstract level. Originality remains subject to independent literature audit.
title: Translation-subgroup geometric fixed spaces of scale-two hypercube Rips complexes
